questions.question: For a feature map shaped (C,50,50), what shape does roi_align_single(..., output_size=7) return?
questions.explanation: The helper samples one region from one feature map and removes the temporary batch dimension, leaving channels by 7 by 7.

questions.question: What does spatial_scale=1/4 do when a box is expressed in image pixels?
options: Makes the pooled output four times larger
Changes the box into four class labels
Adds four channels to the feature map
Maps image coordinates to feature-map coordinates by multiplying them by 1/4
questions.explanation: A feature map with stride four has coordinates one quarter as large as the original image; roi_align_single scales the box before sampling.

questions.question: Why does roi_align_single use bilinear grid_sample rather than rounding each RoI bin to one pixel?
options: It preserves subpixel information and avoids quantization of region boundaries
It removes the need for a backbone feature map
It guarantees every mask is binary before training
It turns RoIs into image-level class labels
questions.explanation: RoIAlign samples at fractional coordinates and interpolates, unlike RoIPool's coarse coordinate quantization.

questions.question: In the pretrained Mask R-CNN output, what does p['masks'] represent?
options: A single image-level class vector
One mask logit/probability map per detected instance, alongside boxes and labels
The FPN feature tensor before RoIAlign
The list of proposal anchor widths only
questions.explanation: The demo prints boxes, labels, and masks as separate per-instance outputs from the detector.

questions.question: What changes when build_custom_maskrcnn(num_classes=5) is called?
options: The FPN is replaced with a grayscale input layer
All RoIs are removed and only image classification remains
The box and mask predictors are replaced with five-class heads
The backbone is automatically quantized to INT8
questions.explanation: The function swaps FastRCNNPredictor and MaskRCNNPredictor while retaining the pretrained backbone and feature pyramid.

questions.question: What does freeze_backbone(model) change in the custom Mask R-CNN?
options: Sets every model parameter to zero
Freezes only the five output class labels
Puts the mask head into training mode
Sets requires_grad=False for parameters in model.backbone, including its FPN
questions.explanation: The helper iterates over model.backbone.parameters(), so the backbone/FPN stay fixed while task heads can be trained.
